name: JV_PROJECT_FILTERS
description: This table contains the project filters within a project filter set to be used by Joint Venture Management processes.

columns.name: FILTER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the joint venture project filter.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: FILTER_SET_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier of the joint venture project filter set that the project filter is associated with.

columns.name: PROJECT_ATTRIBUTE_CODE
columns.description: The project attribute field to filter by. It is based on ORA_JV_PROJ_FILTER_OPERATOR lookup codes such as ORA_JV_PROJECT_NUMBER, ORA_JV_TASK_NUMBER, ORA_JV_EXPENDITURE_TYPE, or ORA_JV_EXPENDITURE_ORG.

columns.name: FILTER_OPERATOR_CODE
columns.description: The code for the filter operator. It is based on ORA_JV_PROJ_FILTER_OPERATOR lookup codes such as ORA_JV_IS, ORA_JV_IS_NOT, ORA_JV_BETWEEN or other defined values.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_LOW_VALUE
columns.description: The value of the project filter or the low value which corresponds to the project filter range.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_HIGH_VALUE
columns.description: The high value which corresponds to the project filter range.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
